meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne-prone (muhase wali) skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar kai acche aur effective serums available hain. Acne ke liye sabse best ingredients **Salicylic Acid (BHA)** ya **Niacinamide** maane jaate hain, jo pores ko saaf karte hain aur extra oil ko control karte hain.

Aapke budget ke andar ye top options best rahenge:

### 1. The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Price:[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-facial-serum-under-1500-india#:~:text=5.%20The%20Derma%20Co%2010%25%20Vitamin%20C,cause.%20*%20Dermatologist-backed%20brand%20gives%20some%20credibility.)** Approx.[www.nykaaman.com](https://www.nykaaman.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20For%20Blackheads,2%25%20Anhydrous%20Solution.%20%E2%82%B9650.%204.4.%20%284.2K%29%20Plum.) ₹549 (30ml)[www.nykaaman.com](https://www.nykaaman.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20For%20Blackheads,2%25%20Anhydrous%20Solution.%20%E2%82%B9650.%204.4.%20%284.2K%29%20Plum.)
* **Kiske liye best hai:** Active acne (chote-bade daane), blackheads aur whiteheads ke liye.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Apply%20at%20night%20to%20start%2C%20and%20it,acne%20mark%20fading%2C%20without%20an%20exfoliating%20acid.)
* **Kaise kaam karta hai:[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Its%20effectiveness%20comes%20from%20tea%20tree%20oil,for%2030ml.%20Rating%3A%204.8%2F5%20on%20official%20website.)** Isme 2% Salicylic Acid hota hai jo skin ke andar jaakar pores ke excess oil aur dirt ko dissolve karta hai.

### 2. The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Serum

* **Price:[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-facial-serum-under-1500-india#:~:text=2.%20Foxtale%2015%25%20Vitamin%20C%20Glow%20Serum,it%20sit%20well%20under%20makeup%20without%20pilling.)** Approx.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Apply%203-5%20drops%20twice%20daily%2C%20and%20it,Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum%20%7C%20Salicylic%20Acid%20%7C) ₹599 (30ml)[www.nykaaman.com](https://www.nykaaman.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=%E2%82%B9600.%204.2.%20%287.4K%29%20The%20Derma%20Co.%20Sali-Cinamide,Combo.%20%E2%82%B91200.%204.3.%20%2810.2K%29%20Dot%20%26%20Key.)
* **Kiske liye best hai:[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Its%20effectiveness%20comes%20from%202%25%20salicylic%20acid%2C,for%2030ml.%20Rating%3A%204.5%2F5%20on%20official%20website.)** Acne aur acne ke purane daag (marks) dono ke ek sath ilaaj ke liye.
* **Kaise kaam karta hai:[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Its%20effectiveness%20comes%20from%20tea%20tree%20oil,for%2030ml.%20Rating%3A%204.8%2F5%20on%20official%20website.)** Isme Salicylic Acid ke sath-sath 5% Niacinamide bhi hota hai, jo oil control karne ke sath daag-dhabbe bhi halka karta hai.

### 3. Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum (with Zinc)

* **Price:[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-facial-serum-under-1500-india#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20Face%20Serum%20%E2%80%93,Texture%3A%20Water-light%2C%20absorbs%20in%20under%2060%20seconds.)** Approx.[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-facial-serum-under-1500-india#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20Face%20Serum%20%E2%80%93,Texture%3A%20Water-light%2C%20absorbs%20in%20under%2060%20seconds.) ₹599 (30ml)[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-facial-serum-under-1500-india#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20Face%20Serum%20%E2%80%93,Texture%3A%20Water-light%2C%20absorbs%20in%20under%2060%20seconds.)
* **Kiske liye best hai:** Agar aapko bahut zyada oily skin hai aur open pores ki problem hai.
* **Kaise kaam karta hai:** Niacinamide skin barrier ko strong banata hai aur Zinc sebum production ko control karta hai taaki naye pimples na niklein.

### 4. Dot & Key 2% Salicylic + Cica Anti-Acne Face Serum

* **Price:[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-facial-serum-under-1500-india#:~:text=2.%20Foxtale%2015%25%20Vitamin%20C%20Glow%20Serum,it%20sit%20well%20under%20makeup%20without%20pilling.)** Approx.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C) ₹550 (20ml - 30ml offers mein sasta mil jata hai)
* **Kiske liye best hai:** Sensitive ya irritated acne-prone skin ke liye.
* **Kaise kaam karta hai:** Isme Salicylic Acid ke sath Cica (Centella Asiatica) hota hai jo acne ki redness aur irritation ko turant soothe karta hai.

---

### Khareedne se pehle kuch zaroori baatein:

* Agar aapko **active pimples aur blackheads** ki problem hai, toh **Salicylic Acid serum** chunें.
* Agar aapko daane kam hain aur **zyada oil & daag-dhabbe** hain, toh **Niacinamide serum** behtar rahega.
* Naye serum ko use karne se pehle patch test zaroor kar lein.
